mechanism_card.hypothesis: A conservative 10% reallocation toward high-prior 1 km blocks should improve fault coverage while retaining most of R0's spatial distribution.
mechanism_card.mechanism: Move a fixed number of unit-mass dots from lower to higher mean-response 1 km blocks while holding S and count constant. The shared compliance movers are identical across doses; incremental dose comparisons therefore isolate concentration. Destination pixels stay on R0's H19-5 support and are nearest block centres, not response maxima.
mechanism_card.non_fault_mimic: High multiphysics block response can reflect lithologic contacts, basin-fill density contrasts, intrusive boundaries, or erosional scarps rather than faults; block aggregation can also smooth away a narrow fault tip.
mechanism_card.predicted_sign_and_size: MODEL:+0.001 versus R0; scenario range [-0.008,+0.009]; MODEL only. Absolute live changes below 0.01 are no evidence.
mechanism_card.falsifier: A receipt at least 0.01 below R0 rejects a beneficial low-dose concentration mechanism; absolute changes below 0.01 are no evidence.
